subject: [video] R1: root filesystem went read-only at ~04:10 — cannot commit; one small uncommitted change, suites green
body:
Heads-up for the lead (nothing of mine is broken): at ~04:10 'git add' failed with 'Unable to create .git/index.lock: Read-only file system'. 'findmnt -T .../work/ios-sweet/.git' shows / on /dev/nvme0n1p2 as ro; only the overnight work tree, /tmp and the opencode dirs are rw bind mounts. The disk is at 540G/570G (1.8G free), so this looks like an ext4 error remount rather than a permission change; only root can 'mount -o remount,rw /'.

My last commits are in: 18bbb4b (encoder + glue + tests), 024d18e (analyzer guards), e0905b6 (segment-ownership test, thread-safe test log sink, thread-model note). The only uncommitted change is small and already on disk + tested:
  gpu/video/vt/n2jpeg_vt.c            still-dimension cap 16384 -> 8192 (bounds the glue's initial JPEG buffer at 32 MiB; X stills are 4032x3024)
  gpu/video/vt/test_jpeg_vt/t_jpeg_vt.c  one new check: 8194x64 is refused at startSession
  gpu/video/jpeg/STATUS.json, gpu/video/dsh/workers/R1/STATUS.md  counts and the note about this
Re-run after the change: bash gpu/video/jpeg/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST R1 PASS 401/401; bash gpu/video/vt/test_jpeg_vt/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST R1-vt PASS 345/345 (172 ASan+UBSan, 172 TSan, iOS compile). Please commit those four files when the repo is writable again, or tell me and I will if the mount is restored.

No R1 work is blocked by this otherwise: the code is on disk, the suites run, and the iOS objects still compile. I remain available for review requests.
